text_block_list.text: On the way home from going out with Vodka—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
My bad. Kept you out late just because I 
said I wanted to drop by that motorcycle 
shop.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Bikes are seriously cool, though. Like... 
every one of them has its own awesome 
point!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It depends on the bike model, and 
the color, and lots of other things—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
How do I put it... Argh, I can't find the 
right words to explain it!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Like, a feeling that hits you right when 
you look at it! Anyway, I just got this 
crazy vibe from it.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Dammit... Why can't you see what makes me 
"cool"?!

Maybe if I try doing things I think are 
"cool," I'll start to understand Vodka's 
standards.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oh! Smart thinking! Let's go with that!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"If I can clearly figure out the key 
points myself, maybe I can master being 
totally cool!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You're right, let's start light—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"How about learning how to order coolly at 
a cafe?"

So, we decided to stop by a cafe that 
Vodka was familiar with.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
By the way, how would you order if it were 
you?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that kinda makes you seem like a 
regular. Sounds cool!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let me place the order here. 
Here goes—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Give me the usual!

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text: The usual...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah, the usual.

"And what was brought out was a parfait 
loaded with whipped cream."
choice_data_list: This is what you call normal...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Wh-What the heck are you saying?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Like hell I'd order something this 
childish!?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Like I've ever eaten a "Rich Whipped 
Cream and Fluffy Strawberry Mousse 
Parfait" before!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...W-Wait! I never said I wasn't gonna eat 
it.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm not really into parfaits, but eating 
it without complaining is the cool thing 
to do!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Alright, down the hatch!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa, that looks so good... Ah, no... I 
didn't say anything!

Saying that, Vodka happily began digging 
into her parfait.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Is that supposed to look cool? They're 
literally just ordering coffee.
choice_data_list:
The "Black" part is what's important, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...I see. So that's where you show off 
your mature coolness.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —Alright, let's order then.

"Taking a sip of the black coffee served 
to me, a rich aroma spreads across my 
palate. Delicious."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, you sure make that look delicious.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Not bad, but... still can't quite call it 
cool yet.
choice_data_list: Aren't you going to order anything, Vodka?
Aren't you going to order anything, Vodka?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Y-Yeah, that's right!

A cup of black coffee is promptly served 
in front of Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I-It's nothin'. That coffee sure looks 
good, don't it?

Vodka picked up the cup and downed the 
coffee with resolve.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
U-Uuu... It's bitter... but damn, this 
bitterness... is irresistible...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If you add stuff like sugar or milk, you 
can't taste the beans at all!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, black coffee really is the best, 
hands down!

I decided to pretend I didn't see Vodka's 
teary eyes after she finished drinking it—
